text:
This summary covers the period from 2026-05-15 to 2026-05-21, encompassing 7 days of ROBI’s operation. During this time, ROBI processed a total of 163 orders, with 58 successfully delivered, 37 delivered with warnings, and 68 orders failing. The average fetch time was 97 seconds, and the median fetch time was 95 seconds, primarily utilizing the [[gripper]] for item retrieval.

Notably, 2026-05-19 was the busiest day with 95 orders, while order #2 for the water bottle experienced a significant delay of 817 seconds, primarily due to a [[search_exhausted]] failure. Across all orders, there were 25 [[retries]] (21 orders needing them), with the most frequent failure types being [[reachability_failed]] (20 times) and [[search_exhausted]] (26 times). There were no [[collision warnings]] recorded during the week.
